outcome: Oxidative stress markers (Total oxidant status (TOS), Total antioxidant status (TAS), Oxidative stress index (OSI), 3-nitrotyrosine, carbonyl, thiol groups)
cohort: The study included 56 pregnant women receiving Atosiban treatment for impending preterm birth.
finding: Administration of Atosiban for impending preterm birth significantly increased oxidative stress markers (decreased TAS, increased TOS, OSI, and carbonyl groups) in pregnant women, with higher post-treatment TOS levels associated with subsequent premature birth.
gest_age: The study focused on women with impending preterm birth, defined as delivery before 37 completed weeks of pregnancy.
